findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses abstract StatefulDetectorHandler without implementing its abstract methods
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler was changed from DetectorHandler (where it implemented evaluate) to StatefulDetectorHandler with just `pass`. StatefulDetectorHandler declares abstract members counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data, none of which are implemented here. Because it inherits from abc.ABC, any attempt to instantiate it (e.g., via Detector.detector_handler for a detector of type metric_alert_fire) will raise TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class. Previously it was instantiable and returned an empty result list. Either implement the abstract methods (even as stubs) or keep the class on the non-abstract base until the stateful abstraction is built.

findings.title: StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The docstring on StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate reads 'Evaluates a given data packet and returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`.' but the method now returns dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]. This contradicts the signature change made in this PR and will mislead implementers of new detector handlers.
